recognize_zh: 低倍IgD染色下一個巨大、不規則的結節被IgD陽性小B細胞填滿，其中散布數個淡染、IgD陰性的生發中心殘島，旁邊另有一個較小的IgD陽性結節，是IgD+外套細胞侵入並瓦解生發中心的PTGC圖像。
features: Very large, irregular nodule diffusely populated by IgD-positive small B cells
Multiple pale, IgD-negative islands representing fragmented residual germinal centers
Smaller adjacent IgD-positive nodule at the right edge
IgD-negative interfollicular/paracortical zones surrounding the nodule
Capsule visible at the lower left
describe_en: Low-power IgD immunostain of lymph node shows a very large irregular nodule diffusely populated by IgD-positive small mantle B cells, within which several pale IgD-negative islands of residual germinal center are dispersed. A smaller IgD-positive nodule lies nearby, and the surrounding paracortex is largely IgD-negative. The expansion of IgD-positive mantle cells into and around fragmented germinal centers is characteristic of progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: NLPHL nodules are also rich in IgD+ small B cells, so the discriminator is the presence of LP cells (CD20+/OCT2+) with PD1+ rosettes and CD21+ FDC meshworks expanded throughout the node.
MCL nodules are cyclin D1/SOX11 and CD5-positive monotypic B cells, often with naked germinal centers rather than fragmented germinal-center islands.
FL shows crowded neoplastic follicles with little IgD+ mantle and BCL2+/CD10+ germinal center cells.
